lines.l: That's Vito Joe, senoritas they all know
When they pass him he will go
That's Vito Joe, neighbors try to make him stop
But they only blow their talk, cannot sleep at all
Because Vito whistles when he snores
We're so high and we're so low
Neighbors try to make him stop
But they only blow their top
He don't whistle when he scores
Whistle, whistle, beat the jump Whistle high and whistle low
